passage.title: Model answer written for TGA
paras: The writer makes the sighting feel sacred by setting a long wait against a few seconds. [structure] The owl 'slid' out 'without a sound', [evidence] a verb of smooth, secret movement [language] that makes it seem more spirit than bird. [effect] The short sentence 'That was all.' [structure] turns the moment into an ending, and the simile of walking home 'as if we had been in a mosque' [language] shows reverence, confirmed when even the talkative brother falls silent. [effect]

model.title: Repair: 'The writer uses a simile, as if we had been in a mosque. This is a simile.'

parts.text: Link to structure: the brother's silence

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The simile 'as if we had been in a mosque' shows the children's reverence, and the structure confirms it: the brother, 'who never stops talking', says nothing until the gate.

questions.q: From your analysis, write your strongest and weakest question
Core: DIRT in the portal response box. Repair your weakest Q4 paragraph using the model. Starter: paste your paragraph, then improve it.
questions.a: A repaired paragraph with an embedded quotation, an effect and a structure link.

questions.q: Extend: write two targets (one reading, one writing)
Stretch: repair a Section C paragraph for AO5
What lifts the model above a mid-level answer?
options: it links language and structure and always explains the effect
questions.a: C) it links language and structure and always explains the effect. Integration and effect are what the top level rewards.

questions.q: The best next step is usually...
questions.a: A) practising the weakest question type

questions.q: Answer the ponder: total or breakdown?
questions.a: The breakdown, because it shows what to practise.
